params.caption: 🖥️ Malaysia and Singapore widen Nvidia AI chip probes Malaysia is investigating possible re-exports of Nvidia AI hardware over fears that US restrictions on China are being dodged. In Singapore, an executive has been charged over suspicious purchases of 917 AI servers, and the firm at the centre of the Jensen Huang controversy says it will audit its inventory of restricted GPUs. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 19:15 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 👀 React if you're following the Nvidia saga · 💬 Where does this end? #Nvidia #AIChips #GPU #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
